correctness.rationale: On coordinate torus set u=X^m,v=Y^m,w=Z^m; p does not divide m so cover is etale. Differences of partials force u=v=w; common-zero criterion 1+3lambda=0. Side restriction is quadratic lambda(v+w)^2+vw; multiple roots exist only in odd characteristic at 1+4lambda=0. At vertices the equation equals lambda, giving ordinary m-fold points only at lambda=0. Fresh symbolic checks verified Heron four-factor identity at -1/4 and omega-linear two-factor identity at -1/3; distinct factors/smoothness and intersection multiplicities follow from p∤m and etale cover. Cremona birationally normalizes integral lambda0 fiber to a smooth Fermat curve. Plane adjunction gives remaining genera. Fq rational points follow from mth roots of unity and quadratic-sign image in Fq*. Small finite field package checker inspected but universality follows from this stratified algebraic proof, not a sample.
